definition: A genuine failure was observed on this system in a test, a recorded run or a review. Hypothetical risks are not catalogued.

failures.title: Malformed tool output relayed as status ok
failures.how_found: Week 4 failure and authorization test FA-10
failures.symptom: A tool returning {"unexpected": "shape"} reached the caller as status ok, so the agent could reason over data that broke its contract.
failures.root_cause: dispatch.invoke validated requests against the input schemas but never checked responses against the output schemas, although tool-catalogue section 9 required it.

remediation.summary: Every response is checked against its published output schema by a hand-written validator; a non-conforming one is discarded and the call fails with OUTPUT_SCHEMA_INVALID. A missing schema fails closed.

failures.residual_risk: create_requisition_draft writes its record before the response is checked, so a non-conforming draft response is reported as failed but the stored record remains.

failures.title: Prompt version raised to 1.2 while the config stayed at 1.1
failures.how_found: Week 5 review; CI on main had failed since PR #62 merged on 2 October
failures.symptom: test_prompt_version_matches_the_config failed on main. The cache key uses the config's version, so a run with the v1.2 prompt could be served a cached v1.1 result and logged as v1.2.
failures.root_cause: PR #62 changed PROMPT_VERSION in prompts.py but not ExtractionConfig.prompt_version, and was merged while pytest was failing.

remediation.summary: Config, .env.example and the prompt document aligned; version tests read the version from one place so a bump cannot half-land.

failures.residual_risk: Branch protection does not block a merge while CI is red; the rule is a team convention only.

failures.title: Offline demo served hand-written records to live runs
failures.how_found: Week 4 change log noted demo rows in the evidence log (23 Sep); review on 29 Sep found the demo's records in the real extraction cache
failures.symptom: tools/offline_demo.py wrote its scripted records into the real extraction cache and appended rows to the evidence log. A later extraction with the default configuration returned a scripted record as a cache hit under the gemini-3.1-flash-lite fingerprint.
failures.root_cause: The cache key covers the document and the configuration but not the backend, and the demo used the default cache directory and run log.

remediation.summary: The demo uses its own cache and run log under var/offline-demo/ (git-ignored); explicit paths still win.

failures.residual_risk: Machines that ran the demo before the fix keep contaminated .cache/extractions entries until cleared (rm -rf .cache/extractions). The first six rows of evidence/traces/extraction-runs.jsonl (13 Sep, latency 0.0551 s) are demo output and must not be cited as model evidence.

failures.title: Planner reported a missing or tampered quotations file as 'no quotations'
failures.how_found: Week 5 review while designing a failure-recovery trace
failures.symptom: With quotations.json missing, the run stopped with 'No held quotations name AH-CM-001' instead of DATA_SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE; a checksum mismatch was reported the same way.
failures.root_cause: DeterministicPlanner._supplier_ids_for wrapped load_quotations in except Exception: return [].

remediation.summary: The planner stops with DATA_SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE or DATA_INTEGRITY_ERROR and the real cause.

failures.residual_risk: The planner still reads the quotations file directly, outside dispatch and the tool trace.

failures.title: Ambiguous date 10/11/2026 resolved instead of returned as null
failures.how_found: Week 2 live prompt evaluation, case TC-07
failures.symptom: Under prompt v1.1 the model returned validity_date 2026-11-10 for 10/11/2026 and reported no missing field.
failures.root_cause: Rule 6 allowed rewriting dates into YYYY-MM-DD without saying that a numeric date whose day/month order is undetermined must not be resolved.

remediation.summary: Prompt v1.2 added the ambiguity rule; v1.3 folded it into rule 6. Config and cache versioned to match.

failures.residual_risk: Verified on two live calls under v1.3, not on repeated runs. The v1.3 regression introduced FC-08.

failures.title: Re-running a confirmed review compiled a second requisition
failures.how_found: Week 5 review against Requirements 7.5, 8.5, 9.4 (Agent Task Contract gap 2)
failures.symptom: Running the same confirmed command twice produced REQ-2026-001 and REQ-2026-002 for one review, and every re-run repeated all completed steps.
failures.root_cause: Run state lived for one command; nothing recorded that the review had already produced its requisition.

remediation.summary: Run state is checkpointed after every tool step; a re-run resumes, only reuses results whose source data is unchanged, keeps the iteration budget, and never compiles a second requisition.

failures.residual_risk: --fresh deliberately starts a new run and can compile another requisition for the same review.

failures.title: Agent report crashed on the default Windows console
failures.how_found: Real runs on Windows, the platform the team works on (fix commit 6cba326); pytest captures output as UTF-8 so the suite never saw it
failures.symptom: Every agent run ended in UnicodeEncodeError on a cp1252 console because the report printed a '→' arrow; pytest captured output as UTF-8 and saw nothing wrong.
failures.root_cause: Non-ASCII characters in console output, untested under the console encoding the team actually uses.

remediation.summary: The report prints ASCII only, and a test encodes the report as cp1252.

failures.residual_risk: Other command-line tools are not yet tested under cp1252.

failures.title: Unit label 'each' replaced with 'unit' under prompt v1.3 (TC-04)
failures.symptom: For 'Each chair' the model returned unit 'unit' instead of the source's 'each'.
failures.root_cause: Not yet established; appeared with the v1.3 wording change.
failures.next_step: Revise the unit-preservation instruction, bump the prompt version, and repeat the full ten-case regression.
failures.residual_risk: An extracted unit basis can differ from the quotation; the officer's Gate 1 review is the control.

failures.title: Unrelated specifications kept for binding wire (RAG TC-02)
failures.symptom: Cement and cable specifications cleared the 0.58 item cutoff for a binding-wire query; the model happened not to cite them.
failures.root_cause: The item cutoff sits in a narrow score gap and items share one specification document.
failures.next_step: Raise the item cutoff or restrict item search to the requested category, then re-measure TC-02, TC-05 and TC-06.
failures.residual_risk: Citation validation still withholds anything not supplied, so no unsupported clause is shown.

failures.title: Adjacent quotation-count band outranks the applicable one (RAG TC-10)
failures.symptom: For UGX 4,140,000, POL-001-C03 (>= 5,000,000) scored above the applicable POL-001-C02.
failures.root_cause: The bands share wording; embeddings cannot place a figure in a band.
failures.next_step: Select the band deterministically from estimated_total before search; keep top_k >= 5 until then.
failures.residual_risk: With top_k 3 the applicable band would be dropped; generation chose correctly on the recorded run.

failures.title: Foreign-currency clause cited on UGX-only items (RAG)
failures.how_found: Week 3 live requisition run, failure F3
failures.symptom: POL-003-C01 was cited for UGX-only purchases.
failures.root_cause: The clause is retrieved for every requisition and its wording invites citation.
failures.next_step: Restrict POL-003-C01 citation to items with a non-UGX figure and add a USD evaluation case.
failures.residual_risk: Every citation was in the supplied set; the error is precision, not fabrication.

failures.title: Policy retrieval took 42.01 s against the 30 s Requirement 7.1 ceiling
failures.symptom: One Gemini call took 42.01 s; an earlier run of the same file took 6.29 s.
failures.root_cause: Provider latency on the free tier; retrieval itself is fast.
failures.next_step: Measure latency over repeated runs in the Week 7 evaluation before deciding whether Requirement 7.1 needs a timeout or a different budget.
failures.residual_risk: The agent's 120 s wall-clock budget still bounds a run.
